WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT
    u.acctscope,
    o.recordvault,
    AVG(f.feerate) - AVG(f.rebrate) AS net_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
  JOIN users AS u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink
  GROUP BY u.acctscope, o.recordvault
  HAVING AVG(f.feerate) IS NOT NULL
     AND AVG(f.rebrate) IS NOT NULL
), per_scope AS (
  SELECT acctscope, AVG(net_rate) AS avg_net_rate, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM per_order
  GROUP BY acctscope
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_rate) AS plain_avg_scope_rate
  FROM per_scope
)
SELECT
  p.acctscope,
  p.avg_net_rate,
  p.order_count,
  p.avg_net_rate - x.plain_avg_scope_rate AS difference_from_plain_avg
FROM per_scope AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS x;

assumptions.assumption: Orders are identified by orders.recordvault, which is the key referenced by fees.orderslink; an order is included only when both its average feerate and average rebrate are present. The comparison baseline is the unweighted average of the per-scope averages returned by the query.
